sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 233665, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: 2026 peak season (April 15 - October 14): standard electric/water site $30 a night; tent-only electric sites $22, group sites $85. The same rates are posted for 2027.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233665/rates (Peak Season 2026-04-15 to 2026-10-14: STANDARD ELECTRIC 30, TENT ONLY ELECTRIC 22, GROUP STANDARD ELECTRIC 85), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233665 ('The other 55 sites have full electrical and water hookups to support RV's') + RIDB catalog (55 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites: 50 at 50 amp, 5 at 30 amp, all Water Hookup Yes; no sewer attribute), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 61 family campsites: 55 electric/water RV sites and 6 tent-only sites with electric, plus two group areas. Catalog Max Vehicle Length on the RV sites runs 33-145 ft (most 43-90 ft); the longest look like pad lengths, so no maximum is recorded. 7 pull-throughs, 48 back-ins.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233665 ('The campground offers 61 family campsites, 6 of these are tent only sites that do have electric hookups') + RIDB catalog (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry per site), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Flush and vault toilets. Amphitheater, playground, basketball court; 17 miles of Warrior Creek mountain-bike/hiking single track loop the campground. Boat ramp and fishing piers at adjoining Keowee Park. Swim beach closed until further notice (notice read 2026-10-22). Firewood and ice cash-only at an honor vault.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233665 ('Amenities include flush and vault toilets, showers, drinking water and a dump station'; notice 'Swim beach is closed until further notice'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'All camping reservations are made in advance. No transactions will be completed at the campground'; changes only through recreation.gov (877-444-6777 or the app). Self check-in with a gate code emailed at booking when the gatehouse is unstaffed. 14 nights in any 30 days. Check-in 3 pm, check-out noon.

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233665 ('Golden Age/Access and America the Beautiful Interagency Senior and Access Passes are accepted at this campground. Cardholders receive a 50% discount on camping fees.'), read 2026-10-22

summary: USACE-run (not concession), reservation-only. Confirmed $30 (2026) base, 50-amp electric + water. Added 61 family sites with 7 pull-throughs, flush/vault toilets, showers, water, dump, no first-come camping, 14-night max, senior/access 50% discount. Calendar is open Apr 15 - Oct 14 (Nov 'Not Available', April 2027 booking) but no season statement, so season not written. Note unchanged. Not stated: sewer, booking window, minimum stay. USACE district page answers 403 to plain HTTP.
